CafeOrder.title: CafeOrder
CafeOrder.description: A cafe kitchen order ticket placed via QR/Barcode table scan or owner entry, with line items, preparation status, and Rupee billing/payment status. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt, updatedAt, and paidAt.

orderNumber.description: Short display ticket number such as #101.

tableOrCustomer.description: Table label, barcode tag, or customer name.

orderType.description: Order placement channel (QR_SCAN for customer QR/barcode orders).

paymentStatus.description: Settlement state of the customer bill.

paymentMethod.description: Method used to settle the bill.

items.description: Bounded list (1 to 25) of ordered line item maps.

subtotalCents.description: Order subtotal in paise/minor currency units.

taxCents.description: Calculated GST/tax in minor currency units.

tipCents.description: Customer tip in minor currency units.

discountCents.description: Applied discount in minor currency units.

totalCents.description: Final payable total in minor currency units.

paymentReference.description: Payment receipt reference or tender note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when order was last updated.

paidAt.description: Optional server timestamp recorded when payment completes.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: A cafe menu item priced in Rupees (paise). Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

priceCents.description: Unit price in minor currency units (paise).

prepMinutes.description: Estimated kitchen preparation duration in minutes.

available.description: Whether the item is currently in stock.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when item was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when item was updated.

QrTableStation.title: QrTableStation
QrTableStation.description: A QR/Barcode ordering station linked to a cafe table or counter. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

tableCode.description: Short barcode/QR table identifier such as T1 or COUNTER.

label.description: Display label such as Table 1 or Window Counter.

linkedUrl.description: Customer QR ordering URL linked to this station.

active.description: Whether QR ordering is active for this station.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when station was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when station was updated.

CafeSettings.title: CafeSettings
CafeSettings.description: Cafe configuration, website portal URL, GST rate, UPI merchant ID, and notification preferences. Clients must write FieldValue.serverTimestamp() for createdAt and updatedAt.

upiId.description: Merchant UPI VPA for QR payments.

taxRatePercent.description: GST/tax percentage applied to order subtotals.

alertsEnabled.description: Whether real-time order alerts are enabled.

soundAlertsEnabled.description: Whether alert chime sound plays on new orders.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were updated.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Real-time cafe QR and counter orders owned by the authenticated cafe owner.

/users/{userId}/menu_items/{itemId}.description: Cafe menu catalog items priced in Rupees.

/users/{userId}/qr_tables/{tableId}.description: Linked QR and barcode table ordering stations.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Cafe settings and portal configuration owned by the authenticated user.
